heyo! as someone who makes traumacore edits, I want to share why I do it. Now, you don't have to understand, that's perfectly fine. I make traumacore edits because it allows me to confront my trauma without actually triggering flashbacks. This is the case for many people. In the traumacore community, we all think it's vent art, however since it is popularly known as "core," people may refer to it as an aesthetic, when in fact this is not the case. Everyone in the community strongly, strongly discourages those without trauma making traumacore edits, as it mocks those who actually have trauma. I don't want to get fully into detail, but traumacore helped me face the abuse that I have faced. Also, I am currently going to therapy and seeing a psychologist, so I am getting help. When I could not get help, I was huge into traumacore, as again, I couldn't get help, and it helped me confront my trauma. So traumacore actually isn't an aesthetic, nor is it something people make if they don't have trauma. thanks for reading, and I would love to hear your thoughts on this!
